Your consent is recorded in accordance with the privacy regulations of the selected region.
CGO-FULI (hereinafter the "Service") biometric analysis (rPPG · face reading · palm reading) at its center, providing integrated Life Index information such as Saju and metaphysics. The core of this service is biometric analysis; Saju and physiognomy are auxiliary indicators. All results are for infotainment·wellness reference and are not medical·legal·investment advice. Users use the service at their own responsibility, and the service is not liable for force majeure such as natural disasters or technical failures. Paid subscriptions follow separate payment terms.
① Items Collected — Email/phone number, nickname, date and time of birth (for metaphysics analysis), biometric analysis results (rPPG, face reading, palm reading, etc.), and service usage records.
② Purpose of Use — Service provision and personalized analysis, service improvement through statistics and research, and storage, statistics, and quality improvement of analysis data when CGO builds its own server in the future..
③ Retention Period — Until account withdrawal or the period stipulated by relevant laws.
④ Current Storage Method — Initially stored on the user's device; after the server is built, it is safely transferred and stored within the scope of consent. Users may refuse consent, but some features may be limited.
Face, tongue, hand, etc. The original video is analyzed only within the device, destroyed immediately after analysis, and never transmitted to the server. Only the result values derived from the analysis may be used after de-identification (with consent).
Measurement result values (BPM, HRV, complexion variables, Five Elements weights, etc.) are separated and de-identifiedfrom your name and email; with consent, they may be used for service improvement, academic research, statistics, and future provision to partner research institutions and dataset use. De-identification greatly reduces the risk of re-identification, but no technology can completely eliminate the risk. This consent is optional; you can use the Service even without agreeing, and you may withdraw or delete it at any time.
⚖️ You have the right to refuse consent (service use may be limited if required items are not agreed to). After signing up, you may withdraw consent and delete your data at any time in Settings.

Health · rPPG
❤️
My Wellness Balance
▼
📌 What is it?Using rPPG (remote photoplethysmography), it reads blood flow from your facial video to estimate your condition across 6 areas such as heart vitality, inner resilience, and stress.
📲 How to use
① In a bright place, fit your face inside the on-screen guide circle
② Removing glasses & masks improves accuracy
③ Look straight ahead without moving for ~15 sec
📊 ResultsScore per 6 areas + overall condition score + areas to watch today.
💡 TipAvoid intense exercise & caffeine right before; measuring at the same time daily makes trends clearer.
⚠️ For reference, not a medical diagnosis.
🧠
Cognitive Wellness Check
▼
📌 What is it?Checks brain condition via cognitive-screening questions (memory, attention, language) and adds guardian, medication & location management.
📲 How to use
① Solve cognitive questions in order (watch timed items)
② Enable guardian linking to share results & location
③ Register medication alerts
📊 ResultsScore per cognitive area + trend graph.
💡 TipMeasuring on the same weekday makes changes easier to see.
⚠️ For wellness reference only, not a diagnosis.
🧴
Scalp Care
▼
📌 What is it?Combines a magnified scalp image with facial rPPG biosignals to analyze scalp condition across 5 areas.
📲 How to use
① Part your hair so the scalp shows
② Hold the camera close to the scalp, in focus
③ Capture 5 areas in turn: crown, front, sides, etc.
📊 ResultsScalp condition per area + custom care guide.
💡 TipBright light, steady hands. Hair that isn't freshly washed can be more accurate.
💡
My IQ
▼
📌 What is it?Solve figure, sequence & language questions; meanwhile your accuracy, reaction speed & heart-rate stability measure focus/skill (BEI).
📲 How to use
① Choose Quick 25 · Standard 35 · Full 90 · Precise 150
② Solve it in one sitting in a quiet place
③ Keep your face visible when bio-resonance sync is on
📊 ResultsEstimated IQ + BEI (guessing vs. real skill) + strengths/weaknesses by area.
💡 TipStopping midway skews reaction-time data. Focus and finish in one go.
⚠️ FULI's own scale (beta). Not a Mensa or clinical IQ test.

② Cover one eye at a time and answer the chart direction
③ Repeat for both eyes
📊 ResultsLeft and right eye clarity index + trend over time.
💡 TipIn your usual glasses/lenses, under the same lighting.
⚠️ Does not replace an eye exam.

🔤 Unfamiliar terms explained simply
ILI — Integrated Life Index
Short for Integrated Life Index. It fuses all Eastern & Western data — Saju, NASA celestial data, rPPG biosignals, numerology — to express your current energy state as 0–100 points. The higher the score, the better your energy today!
rPPG — Remote Photoplethysmography
Short for remote PhotoPlethysmoGraphy. camera-read skin color changes— a technology analyzing these to measure heart rate, blood flow & stress. Measured from facial video alone, without touching — a contactless method. (CGO applies this academically studied technology fused with divination & AR)
Five Elements (五行) — Wood·Fire·Earth·Metal·Water
The core of Eastern philosophy. It classifies all things into Wood (木)·Fire (火)·Earth (土)·Metal (金)·Water (水) five energies. Your birth date sets your elements, used in compatibility, shopping, food recommendations and more.
BEI — Brain Endurance Index
Brain Endurance Index. While solving IQ questions, accuracy·reaction time·and inner resilienceare analyzed together — CGO's own index distinguishing guessing from real skill.
SVI — Skin Vitality Index
Skin Vitality Index. Analyzes how fast your skin surface recovers after press-and-release, analyzing it by camera to quantify recovery elasticity. Use your smartphone instead of a costly beauty device!
Inner resilience — stress recovery elasticity
Heart Rate Variability. Measures the variation between heartbeats. Higher inner resilience means faster stress recovery. It's measured by rPPG scan.
MUFE — Dynamic Multi-Factor Security
CGO's own security technology. Post-quantum standard cryptography (ML-KEM-768) · real-time chaos key · biometric verificationare bound in 9 layers, designed so the password DB is never stored off-device (zero-storage).
VSOP87 — Celestial orbit calculation theory
The high-precision planetary orbit theory used by NASA JPL. in microseconds (millionths of a second), it computes solar-system planet positions and applies them to divination in real time.
50 divination systems — a full set of Eastern & Western philosophy
Saju, Zi Wei Dou Shu, Qi Men Dun Jia, Nine Star Ki, I Ching, Feng Shui, numerology, Tarot, Western astrology, Kabbalah and more — 30 Eastern + 20 Western systems applied together. A balanced analysis that doesn't lean on any single method!
BAI — Bio Activity Index
Bio Activity Index. Computed by combining inner resilience·vitality tone·facial rhythm·and biorhythm, your current total bio-energy score.
Perpetual Calendar (萬歲曆) — the base calendar for Saju
It converts your birth year·month·day·hour into Heavenly Stems & Earthly Branches (60 Gapja), a traditional calendar. It's the starting point for face reading, Saju, compatibility, etc., auto-computed from your entered birth date/time.
CSI — Conflict-Offset Index
Conflict-Offset Index. When the 50 systems reach different conclusions, it reconciles the conflicts into an overall scoreand transparently flags 'disagreement' when they diverge — CGO's own reconciliation method.
❓ FAQ
Q. The camera bio-scan isn't working ▼

A. You need to allow browser camera permission.
📱 iOS Safari: Settings → Safari → Camera → Allow
🤖 Android Chrome: Address-bar lock → Permissions → Allow camera
💡 Installing as a PWA makes permissions easier!

Q. My ILI score is too low ▼

A. ILI reflects today's energy. On low days, it's best not to overexert.
To improve accuracy, ① enter your name, birth date & time correctly and ② complete all 4 bio-scans!

Q. I want to install the app on my home screen ▼

A. the bottom 📲 Install button, or:
📱 iPhone: Safari → Share → Add to Home Screen
🤖 Android: Chrome → Menu → Add to Home Screen
Once installed, you can get notifications too!

Q. How do I measure SVI skin elasticity? ▼

A. Go to All Features → Skin Elasticity Analysis (SVI), then
hold the camera close to your skin and, on the on-screen circle, press and release with your finger. It's more accurate under bright light!

Q.Are the results the same as a hospital test?▼

A. No. All analyses are for infotainment & wellness reference, not a medical diagnosis. If you are worried about your health, be sure to consult a medical institution.

Q.Do I have to enter my info?▼

A. Yes. Saju, divination & ILI need your birth date/time to be computed. Before entering info, all features are locked . (Dashboard → Enter info)

Q.What is an rPPG bio-scan?▼

A. A method that uses the camera to read subtle facial blood-flow changes, reading them contactlessly to measure vitality tempo·inner resilience, and more. It’s more accurate when measured in a bright place without movement.

Q.My readings differ each time▼

A. Biosignals (heart rate, blood flow) vary with condition, lighting & posture — varying each time is normal. Try measuring several times under the same conditions.

Q.Is 'World's First' real?▼

A. It refers to CGO's own fusion structure, CGO-FULI's integrated technology. The key is the 'structure' binding these together, not the individual parts.

Q.Are IQ·BEI scores certified tests?▼

A. No. FULI's own scale (beta), not a Mensa or clinical IQ test. Please treat it as fun & self-check.

Q.Is my data safe? Where is it stored?▼

A. By default, measurement data is processed on-device. MUFE security aims for post-quantum cryptography and a zero-storage structure. (see the Privacy Policy for details)

Q.How do I earn and use Stars (⭐)?▼

A. Earn Stars via check-ins & activity, used for some features. My Page → Vault, where you can check them or top up at the Star Station.

Q.Should I trust the stocks, lucky numbers & fortunes?▼

A. All For reference & entertainment. Stocks especially are not investment advice — decisions & responsibility are your own.

Q.Where do I see the Detailed Analysis Report?▼

A. After completing info entry + bio-scan, All Features → Detailed Analysis Report, where you can see Saju, Nine-Star & ILI all at once.

Q.How do I do Couple Compatibility?▼

A. Each person measures their rPPG, then combines it with Saju to read real-time compatibility. All Features → Couple Compatibility, go there to proceed.

Q.How do I cancel/refund my subscription?▼

A. My Page → Subscription & Payment Management, where you can request it.

1️⃣ In a quiet place, bring your question clearly to mind

4️⃣ Cards aren't verdicts or prophecy — they're 'a mirror of you now'
5️⃣ Take results as reference; choices & decisions are always yours
⚠️ Tarot doesn't fix the future. Use it as a tool to sort out your thoughts.

01🛡️ MUFE 9-layer post-quantum security
🏆 World's FirstA Zero-Server-based hybrid authentication shield
We bound the US NIST-standard post-quantum cryptography (ML-KEM-768), 0.03-second-cycle chaos real-time randomness, and rPPG biometric verification into 9 layers, sealed inside the device (TEE), and built a source-blocking security architecture that 'makes the server password DB itself not exist' — the very home base of hacking.
02🔬 Hybrid eyesight-estimation structure
🏆 World's FirstA precise distance-controlled smart eye-test system
By organically combining rPPG bio-signal verification, real-time AR distance interlock, and display noise-cancellation, we built a contactless eyesight-estimation pipeline that operates only within a specified precision-error range.
03🧬 Multimodal bio-fusion interaction
🏆 World's FirstA voluntary-involuntary signal cross-verification architecture
By cross-analyzing in real time the user’s voluntary AR-coordinate behavior with involuntary signals of the inner-resilience system (blood flow, pupils, breathing) that cannot be self-controlled, we built a biometric-authenticity structure that blocks fake faces and deepfakes.
04🌟 Brain Endurance Index
🏆 World's FirstA 3-dimensional-variable-linked true-skill metric
By computing cognitive-question accuracy, reaction time, and HRV stability in real time, we built an original metric that overcomes the Mensa ceiling effect and precisely distinguishes mere guessing from innate intelligence.
05🧠 Cognitive-question · biosignal-synchronized measurement
🏆 World's FirstA real-time momentary-brain-load sync-tracking engine
Breaking the limits of static tests, we built a structure that synchronously tracks, second by second, the real-time cognitive load arising each moment you solve an IQ question against rPPG biosignal waveforms.
06🎨 AR-mesh-based rPPG computation control
🏆 World's FirstA high-stability·low-heat on-device biosensing structure
By physically locking the rPPG computation region (ROI) inside a 3D AR-mesh coordinate system, we built a structure that effectively cancels the user's vigorous-shaking noise and controls the phone's compute overload and heat.
07🎨 Optical-spectrum ghost-free AR rendering
🏆 World's FirstA dynamic-environment noise-cancelling virtual-filter technology
By computing and correcting the optical-spectrum density of ambient light in real time, we built a high-precision AR rendering structure where ghosting and pixel breakup are cancelled even as the subject moves in a dynamic environment.
08🎵 Space-time cosmic-environment variable-frequency music
🏆 World's FirstA 5-dimensional closed-loop real-time audio-synthesis structure
On top of your real-time rPPG bio-rhythm data, we fuse location-based [NASA satellite planetary data × 24 directions × weather × quantified metaphysics algorithms] to build an audio engine that generates, second by second, relaxation frequencies (binaural beats) just for you in this moment.
09🌌 ILI (Integrated Life Index)
🏆 World's FirstA grand-unified inner-outer body-energy balance index
By cross-computing the vast external space-time flow of fortune (divination numeric variables) with the human body's real-time condition, we built an energy-quantification structure that multi-dimensionally judges 'even if the environmental flow is good, can the physical body accept it?'.
10🔮 50-system integrated control engine (CSI)

We fine-tune the contradictions and conflicts among 50 Eastern & Western divination models worldwide with the CSI (Conflict-Offset Index) algorithm, and built a grand-unified formula structure that transparently visualizes even academic disagreements as data.

The world's first camera-based rPPG technology & FaceMesh 468 landmarks, Eastern divination (Saju Five Elements) into real-time AR makeup. ⚡ Distinguishing tech
📜
rPPG bio-technology
A proprietary algorithm that scans your skin's unique optical vitality tone in real time using only the camera. It analyzes your inner vitality rhythm with a single smartphone.
🎯
468-point face landmarks
Tracks the lips, cheeks, and eyelids in fine detail across 468 points to apply makeup naturally.
🌈
130-color library by element
130 curated colors matched to 5 elements × 4 areas (lips·cheeks·eyes·base) via color psychology. Auto-recommended by your Saju.
⚖️
Auto Saju × element fusion analysis
It analyzes your Saju to derive today's element balance and auto-recommends matching colors. Not a mere trend color — *the color that fits you*.
🛡️
Multi-verification accuracy system
A multi-verification system that auto-blocks analysis in poor conditions, for reliable results.

⑤
Apply AR makeup — pick a recommended color and it applies naturally to lips·cheeks·eyes.

📚 Sleep guide▾
SLEEP GUIDE · evidence-based

Sleep guide

We've honestly organized it down to the scientific-evidence grade.

Regular aerobic exercise Widely recommended
Brisk walking·cycling·swimming, 30 min, 3–5 times a week. Multiple meta-analyses confirm it shortens time-to-sleep and improves sleep quality. The key is a similar time each day— consistency.
Yoga·stretching·Tai Chi Worth considering
Shifts the body into relaxation mode. Studies report improved sleep. Good for light movement before bed.
Recommended pre-sleep moves
• Legs up the wall(legs-up-the-wall) 5 min
• Cat-cow poseto relax the spine
• Lying down, pull knees to chest
• Slowly roll neck·shoulders → with this app's 4-7-8 breathing
⚠️ Intense exerciseraises core temperature and can disrupt sleep. Within an hour of bed, only light stretching, not hard exercise.
Shenmen point (HT7) Many studies
On the inner-wrist crease, the hollow on the pinky side. The best-known pressure point for sleeplessness. Alternate both hands press firmly for 1–2 min while breathing.
Anmian point
Behind the ear, below the mastoid, the hollow. As its name ('peaceful sleep') suggests, an extra point for sleep. Press gently in circles with your index finger.
Sanyinjiao (SP6) · Yongquan (KI1)
• Sanyinjiao: four finger-widths above the inner ankle — calming
• Yongquan: the hollow in the front third of the sole — draws down risen energy (cools the head)
Yintang point
Between the brows. Gently pressing the third eye releases tension. Do it last, in bed.
📌 In systematic reviews, acupressure (especially Shenmen·Anmian) mildly improves, with little strain. However, medical treatment doesn't replace medication or treatment.
2 kiwis (1 hour before bed) Reference level
Small studies report improved time-to-sleep and sleep duration, likely from serotonin·antioxidants.
Tart cherry (juice) Reference level
Known to help sleep rhythm. Small studies show increased sleep time.
Warm milk·nuts·banana
Tryptophan, calcium, magnesium aid relaxation (traditional, gentle). Almonds, walnuts, bananas are typical.
Avoid Widely recommended
• Caffeine: half-life 5–6 hours → avoid after 2 PM
• Alcohol: you fall asleep fast but it disrupts REM·causes early waking
• Pre-bed overeating·high-fat: a digestive burden
The key isn't so much 'what you eat' as cutting these threeis widely recommended.
Refining sleep habits Widely recommended
of sleep-habit tuning a representative methodis recommended. Doing it consistently helps refine your sleep rhythm.
Align your circadian rhythm Widely recommended
10–30 min of morning sunlight + a consistent wake time daily. The single most powerful habit. Weekend sleep-ins also disrupt the rhythm.
A cool room (18–20°C)
A drop in core temperatureis the sleep signal. Keep the room slightly cool, hands/feet warm.
Light · sleep rhythm
1 hour before bed, reduce screens·blue light. Sleep-rhythm support is used for jet lag, shift work, etc. helps short-term & limited rhythm correctionis known.
Why this app's breathing works
Slow exhales → body's relaxation response → Vitality beat↓ · inner resilience↑. This app actually measuresthat change with the camera.
Self-hypnosis isn't Worth considering
supernatural — it's guided relaxation + positive self-suggestion. Progressive muscle relaxation, imagery, and autosuggestion are components of sleep relaxation, improved sleep is reported. Play a sound, close your eyes, and slowly follow or listen along below.
1 · Begin relaxing (0–10 sec)
Slowly close your eyes and rest your mind only on the sounds reaching your ears. The screen's light is off, and the tension around your eyes and forehead gently melts away.
2 · Breathe·relax (10–20 sec)
Let the tension in your neck and shoulders drop. Fill your breath slowly through the nose, pause, and exhale long through the mouth. With each exhale, the day's tension leaves with it.
3 · Positive suggestion (20–30 sec)
Right now I am in the safest, quietest place. Today was enough, and tomorrow morning I wake feeling much lighter. These sounds carry me into peaceful sleep. And so I drift off.
📌 The effect comes from steady repetition. However, relaxation is a supportive tool, and medical treatment doesn't replace medication or treatment. If sleep problems last over 2 weeks, consult a professional.
